mentions.name: liblinux
mentions.description: This project is a revival of the author's Rust library liblinux, resumed to take advantage of how far Rust has come since 2019, notably the stabilized inline assembly macro, with the author using the effort to learn Rust.
mentions.source_excerpt: Meanwhile, I decided to revive my Rust liblinux project. Rust has come a long way since 2019, notably the inline assembly macro has been stabilized. I will learn Rust this time!
mentions.author: matheusmoreira
